findings.label: Recycled-slug silent suffix
findings.detail: StoreProductRequest and UpdateProductRequest validate slug uniqueness only against products.slug, not product_slug_histories.old_slug. A slug that lives in history passes validation, makeUnique() silently appends -2, and the product is saved with a different slug than the admin entered. Fix: add Rule::unique('product_slug_histories', 'old_slug') to the slug rules in both Form Requests.

findings.label: Availability check fires only on blur (create form)
findings.detail: The checkSlug fetch in create.blade.php is bound to the blur event. An admin who never leaves the slug field before clicking Submit will see no availability indicator. Moving to a debounced input listener matches the name-field pattern and satisfies the spec requirement that the indicator be present before submission.
